profile.campus: True North Data campus, Loudoun County, VA (Loudoun County zoning case ZMAP-2017-0003, PIN 194103673000, approved Jan 2018)
profile.reading: This building sits at 42254 Thunderball Drive in Leesburg, Virginia, part of a data center campus that Loudoun County own zoning and permitting records identify by the project name True North Data. Loudoun County zoning case ZMAP-2017-0003, filed under that project name, rezoned roughly 105 acres to Planned Development-Office Park specifically to allow data center uses, and was approved January 18, 2018. The underlying parcel, county PIN 194103673000, covering roughly 97 acres, is recorded under a condominium-regime plat named True North Land Condo, a legal structure commonly used to subdivide one large hyperscale campus parcel into separately titled buildings, consistent with the six separate addresses and building records that make up this cluster. A 2019 grading permit for a project called True North 2 described three data center buildings with utilities, and a 2023 stormwater permit for True North Data Phase 2A covered a further 16.5 acres of disturbed area, indicating a phased expansion. Four tenant fit-up zoning permits were issued across April and May 2025, suggesting the campus was still being built out in phases as recently as that year. No document reviewed this session, however, gives a total megawatt capacity, final building count, or total square footage for the completed campus, and the identity of the corporate entity that actually filed the original 2017 rezoning application is not exposed in the county public zoning-case layer, so True North Data Solutions, the name this record carries as operator, could not be independently confirmed as a registered company through the Virginia State Corporation Commission this session. Loudoun County is widely described as the largest data center market in the world by capacity, and Leesburg location within it, near the eastern edge of the county fiber and power-dense corridor, is consistent with why a developer would pursue a multi-building campus of this scale here specifically.

profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap record is labeled TikTok Data Center and sits within a data center campus in Leesburg, Virginia, that Loudoun County own zoning and permitting records identify by the project name True North Data. That project name traces to Loudoun County zoning case ZMAP-2017-0003, which rezoned roughly 105 acres to Planned Development-Office Park specifically to allow data center uses and was approved January 18, 2018, on a parcel, county PIN 194103673000, recorded under a condominium-regime plat named True North Land Condo, a structure commonly used to subdivide one large hyperscale campus into separately titled buildings. Direct review of this record own OpenStreetMap edit history, however, shows that the TikTok Data Center name was not present when the building was first mapped in May 2025 under operator True North Data Solutions. It was added six months later, in a November 2025 edit by the same single contributor, whose changeset comment reads only Changed name and whose source field cites nothing more than local knowledge, with no linked news article, corporate filing, or permit record supporting the change. No trade press coverage, Loudoun County zoning-case record, or corporate filing naming TikTok or its parent company ByteDance in connection with this address or the broader True North Data project could be located during this research, given that general web search was unavailable this session, so given the significance of a claim connecting a foreign-owned social media company to a specific piece of American data center infrastructure, this record does not assert TikTok occupancy as fact. It should be read as an unconfirmed, single-source claim pending independent corroboration, presented alongside the same well-documented county zoning and permitting history that applies to every building on this campus, none of which gives a total megawatt capacity, building count, or square footage for the completed campus.

profile.specialization: Air-cooled and liquid immersion data center solutions, professional hosting services, technology optimization for enterprise computing

reading:
True North Data Solutions is a privately held data centre developer and operator headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, at Unit 4121, 4221 23B Street Northeast, with offices in Canada and the United States. It sells more than building shells. Its own description covers air cooled designs tuned to local climate, liquid immersion cooling for high density racks, grid connected power integration with electrical utilities, on site power from mobile generation units, hardware integration with server manufacturers, custom firmware and facility management software, and remote operations through SCADA. The immersion cooling and mobile generation together mark it out from the wholesale developers this registry mostly holds.

The company states a portfolio of more than ten project sites across three countries on two continents and 673 megawatts of capacity and growing. That number should be handled carefully and is not recorded as capacity here. True North does not say whether it counts critical IT load, contracted utility service, on site generation, or some mixture, and since the company sells both utility interconnection and mobile on site generation, the figure could legitimately mean more than one thing. It is a company claim about a global pipeline, not a measured load at any building.

All six rows this registry holds sit in Loudoun County, Virginia, and they describe one site rather than six. Five are building footprints on Thunderball Drive in Leesburg, postcode 20175, each mapped as a single storey structure, at numbers 42254, 42255, 42310, 42311 and 42370. The sixth is not a building at all. It is an industrial land use polygon named True North Data Centers with the address 20632 Sycolin Road, and its own source tag credits Loudoun County WebLogis, the county's public mapping system. All six lie within roughly 300 metres of one another. Counting a site boundary alongside the buildings inside it is exactly the kind of aggregation artifact that inflates facility counts, and this operator's count of six should be read as one campus.

One of those footprints, 42370 Thunderball Drive, is named TikTok Data Center in the map data while still carrying True North as operator. Occupancy and operation are different things, and a tenant label typed into a map is not evidence of either. The registry should not treat that name as establishing who owns, operates or occupies the building.

The site sits inside the densest data centre market in the world. Loudoun County Economic Development describes roughly 9 million square feet of data centre space in the county and says more than 70 percent of the world's internet traffic passes through networks of companies located there. Against that backdrop, what True North itself publishes is thin. Its site names no Virginia location, no building sizes, no commissioning dates, no founding year and no leadership, and no utility service, standby generation or IT load figure has been published for any of the Leesburg buildings.
